a.description: input array of shape ``(..., M, N)``.

output.description: A tuple ``(lu, piv)`` - ``lu`` is an array of shape ``(..., M, N)``, containing ``L`` in its lower triangle and ``U`` in its upper. - ``piv`` is an array of shape ``(..., K)`` with ``K = min(M, N)``, which encodes the pivots.

constraints: jax.scipy.linalg.lu_solve requires this function's output as input
